title: Customer discovery plan
intro: A short plan for testing your riskiest assumptions with real customers before you build. It's for you and anyone helping with interviews, and it ends with a date to decide.

fields.label: Company or project name
fields.help: A working name is fine, such as "Groomer booking app", and you can change it later.

fields.label: Who exactly is your customer?
fields.help: Describe them precisely enough to find 10 of them this week: "owners of independent bakeries with one shop" works, "small businesses" doesn't.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Mobile dog groomers who work alone and take bookings by phone

fields.label: Your three riskiest assumptions
fields.help: Write each as a statement that could turn out false, riskiest first, for example "Groomers will pay a monthly fee rather than keep using free messaging apps".

fields.label: Your interview questions
fields.help: Ask about what people did recently, not what they think of your idea, for example "Tell me about your last late cancellation. What did you do?"

fields.label: Where you'll find 10 people to talk to
fields.help: Name specific places, groups or people rather than "social media", for example "the regional groomers' association forum" or "one introduction from each groomer I already know".

fields.label: What would prove you wrong
fields.help: Describe what you'd need to hear or see to drop or change your riskiest assumption, for example "most groomers say late cancellations happen less than once a month".

fields.label: The test you'll run
fields.help: Choose one simple test, such as a landing page, a hand-delivered version or a pre-order, and say exactly what people will be asked to do, for example "pay a small deposit to join the first group of users".

fields.label: Your success threshold
fields.help: Set a number before you start so you can't redefine success afterward, for example "at least 4 of 20 groomers pay a deposit".
fields.placeholder: e.g. At least 4 of 20 groomers pay a deposit

fields.label: The date you'll decide
fields.help: Pick a date two to six weeks away, such as four weeks from today, when you'll choose to continue, change course or stop.
